account_roles.EXPENSE: operating expenses, base currency, not linked to documents
account_roles.FX_CLEARING: clearing account for currency conversion of payments
account_roles.UNAPPLIED: received cash not applied to any invoice, payment currency

allocation.description: Payments are processed in timestamp order. A payment is applied to the invoices in invoice_refs in the listed order, to each at most its open balance computed from documents. The remainder is booked to UNAPPLIED. invoice_refs = null means the whole amount goes to UNAPPLIED. Negative payments (refunds) apply the same rule to negative open balances (credit notes).

duplicates.description: Each order_ref is invoiced once; each invoice_id belongs to one document.

fx.booking: foreign payment: Dr FX_CLEARING and Cr AR/UNAPPLIED in payment currency; Dr CASH and Cr FX_CLEARING in base currency for the converted amount

rate_date_options.payment_local_date: local date of the payment timestamp in the company timezone
rate_date_options.payment_local_date_minus_1: the day before the local date of the payment
rate_date_options.payment_utc_date: UTC date of the payment timestamp

fx.rate_meaning: 1 unit of source_currency = rate units of target_currency

issue_types.duplicate_invoice: The same sale is invoiced and booked more than once: two or more invoice documents share an invoice_id, or share an order_ref. affected_ids = doc_id of every copy. Amount = (copies - 1) * |total_minor|, invoice currency.
issue_types.fx_conversion: A foreign-currency payment is converted with the wrong rate (wrong date or wrong pair). affected_ids = [payment doc_id]. Amount = |booked CASH - expected CASH|, base currency.
issue_types.payment_allocation: A payment is not applied to an invoice it references as the allocation rule requires: missing, partial, or booked against another invoice. One finding per (payment, invoice) pair that received less than expected. affected_ids = [payment doc_id, invoice doc_id]. Amount = expected minus actual amount applied, payment currency.
issue_types.period_cutoff: A document's ledger entry is posted in a different reporting period than the document date (local date in the company timezone). affected_ids = [document doc_id]. Amount = |document amount|, document currency.

period.document_date: local date of the document timestamp in the company timezone
period.posting_date: local date of the ledger entry timestamp in the company timezone
